test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which term refers to "The psychological phenomenon in which people are more likely to commit unethical acts when they feel their actions are not being observed"?
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Deindividuation**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Deindividuation** refers to the psychological phenomenon in which individuals lose their sense of self-awareness and accountability in group settings or when they believe their actions are not being observed. (स्व-चेतना और जवाबदेही का ह्रास) • **Example:** During large public protests, some individuals may engage in acts of vandalism due to deindividuation as they feel less identifiable in the crowd. • In such situations, people often act in ways they might not when alone because the anonymity reduces their sense of personal responsibility. (निजी जिम्मेदारी का कम महसूस करना) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Deindividuation**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Cognitive Dissonance** (संज्ञानात्मक असंगति): The mental discomfort experienced by a person when they hold contradictory beliefs or attitudes, or when their actions contradict their values. • **Example:** A smoker who knows smoking is harmful may feel cognitive dissonance while continuing to smoke. • **Self-Justification** (आत्म-औचित्य): The act of providing excuses or explanations for one's actions or decisions to preserve self-esteem or avoid guilt. • **Example:** After missing a deadline, she justified her delay by blaming the excessive workload. • **Moral Disengagement** (नैतिक विच्छेदन): The process of convincing oneself that ethical standards do not apply to oneself in a particular situation. • **Example:** A corporate executive might morally disengage by rationalizing harmful business practices as necessary for profit. d1:T580, The correct answer is **option 1**.
